accessibility.doc: UI accessibility settings (SPEC §6.11; docs/kb/art/ui.md §4.2, §5 and §9; docs/kb/tech/ui.md § Accessibility). UiSettings reads this file; the settings menu lists `settings` in order and shows each option through its loc key.

battle_speed.doc: M2-UI-23: battle_speed options are presentation speed multipliers (the same id and values as M2-BPR-03's BattleChoreo speed). Every battle presentation duration is divided by the speed (UiSettings.battle_time_scale): the controller's pacing waits, damage numbers and float words, the camera shake and the hit recoil. Never the engine, never a Swell input window (those stay real time).

summon_cinematics.doc: M2-UI-23: summon_cinematic option -> the cut of a Vowbound's call cinematic (SPEC 6.3: full on first use, then shortened, with a skip toggle), for the first call of that Vowbound and for every later call. full = every beat, short = the cinematic's middle beats skipped, none = straight to the effect. UiSettings.summon_cinematic_cut(first_call) answers it; the cinematic itself is M2-BPR-07.

text_speeds.doc: M2-UI-12: text_speed option -> multiplier of the dialogue box's default chars_per_sec (text_box.json), clamped to its min/max; 0 = instant (the box shows the whole line at once).

dialogue_backings.doc: M2-UI-12: dialogue_backing option -> the alpha of the panel_low band behind dialogue and cutscene lines (0 = none).

timing_assist.doc: M2-UI-01: what each timing_assist option does to a Swell input row (swell.json inputs, every kind) before the input is built. window_scale widens the windows, clamped per kind so the row still passes validate_data (max_duration_sec is its longest input, edge_margin_sec keeps the brace's counter window clear of the last blow); assist_floor is the quality a miss is recorded at (SwellInput._record); assist_hold (M2-UI-14, 'hold') applies that floor only while Confirm is held, so holding Confirm plays the input by itself; tag_key is the short tag the input panel shows while the assist is on. Numbers: docs/kb/design/formulas.md section Swell, Timing assist.
